plot_3d_pointcloud: plot a 3D point cloud with optional bounding boxes and segmentation coloring using Plotly
plot_bounding_box: add a 3D bounding box to a Plotly figure with specified min and max corners
print_colored_text: display text with colored ANSI spans to highlight multiple object instances in LX3D data
colors_as_rgb: generate a tensor of RGB color values including six named colors and 250 random colors
colors_as_ansi: return a list of ANSI escape codes for terminal text coloring with six named colors
